Coins you collect and finishing bonuses add up. Save enough to unlock new parts. Every part has trade-offs. Progress is saved automatically.

1P · left side of keyboard

W gas S brake AD steer
Left Shift or F drift
E or Q item R look back

2P · right side of keyboard

↑ gas ↓ brake ←→ steer
Right Shift or Numpad 0 drift
Enter item Right Ctrl look back

The first gamepad is 1P and the second is 2P. Either player can use a gamepad.

↑W gas ↓S brake/reverse ←→ steer SpaceShift hop & drift (hold through a turn, release to boost)
EX use item (hold to trail a banana or shell behind you, release to fire, hold ↓ to throw backward)
C look back press drift in the air off a ramp for a trick tuck in behind a kart to slipstream up to 10 coins, more coins = higher top speed
P pause M mute · hold gas when “2” appears for a rocket start · gamepads supported

How to play

Keyboard

← → or A DSteer (gas is automatic)
↓ or SBrake / reverse
Space or ShiftHold in a turn to drift, release for a boost
E or XUse item
P / MPause / mute

Phone and tablet

Gas is automatic. Steer with ◀ ▶, hold DRIFT in turns, tap ITEM to use your item.

Gamepad

Stick to steer, right button for gas, RB to drift, LB for items.

2 players

1P: WASD, Left Shift to drift, E for items. 2P: arrow keys, Right Shift to drift, Enter for items.

Privacy

Star Kart does not collect any personal data and has no accounts, chat or external links. Your progress is saved through CrazyGames, whose Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions apply while you play here.
